summary: Scage Future filed a Form 6-K disclosing a home country rule exemption under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5615 regarding corporate governance requirements. The registrant, a China-based truck and bus bodies manufacturer incorporated in the Cayman Islands, stated it will follow home country rules to be exempt from shareholder approval requirements under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5620(a). No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return is involved. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angles.
